--> About | Alex Solly Design top of page ALEX SOLLY DESIGN FREELANCE FASHION PRINT DESIGNER Home Portfolio About Testimonials Contact Print Shop More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. Alex Solly Design creates trend-led commercial prints for fashion. With a strong focus on trends, colour and newness you can expect bold animals, mark making and stylised florals. With 15+ years’ industry experience, all prints are supplied in repeat and ready for production. ​ Exclusive artworks are available to purchase through the Print Shop in addition to availability for freelance design services. ABOUT ABOUT ME ​ ​ I'm a freelance fashion print designer based in Manchester with 15+ years' experience working with some of the UK's top brands, suppliers and print studios. I've created best-selling designs which have featured in press shows, TV adverts and billboard campaigns. With a strong eye for colour and layout, I'm skilled in identifying emerging trends and translating these into commercial print designs in-line with specific fashion markets and demographics. ​ After graduating with a degree in textile design, I spent 10 years working in-house at various brands, retailers and suppliers before setting up as freelance in 2020. My freelance career has seen me continue to design for high street brands and retailers as well as working with many independent/start up brands and regularly selling designs in the UK, Europe and the US through a global print studio. ​ In addition to offering freelance design services, a print shop is now available to purchase exclusive artworks, meaning design support can be tailored to suit each business's individual needs. ​ ​ SERVICES INCLUDE ​ Print designs – all prints supplied in repeat Trend development & mood boards ​​ Catwalk reports Reworking & recolouring existing artworks Digitising & reworking vintage prints Placement graphic artworks Pantone matching artworks ​ Want to work together? View my portfolio to get a feel for my work and get in touch to discuss how I can help. ​ Looking to purchase exclusive artworks? Request access to my print shop here . I have worked with and sold to a variety of well known brands including; © 2025 by Alex Solly Design | Manchester | alex@alexsollydesign.com Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions © Copyright Alex Solly bottom of page
